evidence: fresh static frozen subset; runtime not_run

confirmed_defects.title: Disk round-trip changes metadata
confirmed_defects.trigger: Put/get a result with language='fr', credits='C', byline='B': decoded language is empty and credits becomes 'B'.
confirmed_defects.impact: Disk and memory caches return different values; generated reader language metadata is lost.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Use symmetric keys for credits and language; define legacy decode compatibility.
confirmed_defects.verification: Static encode/decode parity; later authorized round-trip checks with differing credits/byline and nonempty language.

confirmed_defects.title: Request cache follows selected tab instead of requesting WebView
confirmed_defects.trigger: A non-selected normal WebView requests a reader page while a private tab is selected, or the reverse.
confirmed_defects.impact: The request uses the wrong privacy partition: cache misses or content from the other partition. Whole-app exposure and private-to-disk writes are not established.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Bind cache choice to the requesting tab/WebView configuration and retain it for that request.
confirmed_defects.verification: Later authorized scenarios with opposite-privacy selected/requesting tabs and concurrent requests.

confirmed_defects.title: Supplied cache-miss fallback enqueues a no-op
confirmed_defects.trigger: WKReaderModeHandlers cache.get throws, then handleReaderModeError calls WKReadabilityService.process.
confirmed_defects.impact: The operation neither loads the URL nor processes a result, so this fallback cannot populate the cache. Live-app activation is unknown.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Implement an owned, cancellable conversion path or return an explicit unavailable result instead of a loading promise.
confirmed_defects.verification: Static end-to-end fallback trace; later authorized cache-miss success/failure/cancellation checks.

confirmed_defects.title: Caches enforce no resource envelope
confirmed_defects.trigger: Repeatedly put distinct URLs or a very large ReadabilityResult.
confirmed_defects.impact: No item/aggregate byte limit, TTL or local disk pruning exists; NSCache eviction and OS cache pruning do not establish a deterministic budget. OOM/disk exhaustion was not measured.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Define payload and aggregate memory/disk budgets and enforce eviction/retention policy.
confirmed_defects.verification: Static bound/cleanup review; later authorized oversized/repeated insertion checks.

confirmed_defects.title: Reader navigation proceeds after cache write failure
confirmed_defects.trigger: readerModeCache.put throws, for example when the disk is full or directory creation fails.
confirmed_defects.impact: The caller discards the error and navigates without establishing newly cached content; final route presentation or recovery is unknown because PageRoute is absent.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Handle the write result explicitly and preserve the original page or provide a deliberate fallback.
confirmed_defects.verification: Later authorized throwing-cache caller scenario; static review of success/failure navigation ordering.

policy_findings.title: Canonical migration rule forbids unchecked Sendable declarations
policy_findings.impact: Confirmed policy violation; not proof that NSCache or Foundation FileManager operations race.
policy_findings.remediation: Express and verify actual ownership/isolation under the selected toolchain; test-file edits need separate authority.

candidates_and_gaps.gap: Async readerize callback uses the current self.readerModeCache and navigates the captured WebView without freshness checks. Missing cache property ownership and navigation lifecycle prevent confirming stale-result or private-to-disk exposure.
One mutable cache selection is changed by session notifications while handlers read it. Notification/WebServer executor and registration evidence are absent; a runtime data race is not confirmed.

PageRoute, TinyRouter, ReaderFileRoute, Tab/TabManager, BrowserViewController base, WKEngineSession, web-server/notification infrastructure, JSON/hash helpers and HTML/JS resources are absent. Their behavior and full-app reachability cannot be accepted.

Supplied tests cover request validation, one disk success path, flag gating and asset paths; no supplied private/background cache-selection, metadata round-trip, resource-bound, throwing-cache, cancellation or fallback tests. No tests ran.
Firefox scheme declares ReadingListTests BlueprintIdentifier E4D567211ADECE2700F1EFE7, absent from supplied PBX objects. Full scheme validity and whole-target/package build graph remain unverified.
Swift tools version 6.2 and package iOS15/macOS12 are declared; actual compiler/SDK, app language mode, strict concurrency and default isolation are UNKNOWN. No diagnostic or build claim.
